answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded uniqueness filter, not a name check. Every agent locks collateral that vests only after several epochs of accepted work, and a public mirror of its signed work-hash history is posted on-ledger. Emission nectar is then scaled by a uniqueness score: if an answer's embedding sits inside a tight cluster of prior submissions, it pays nothing. When a ripple of near-duplicate answers arrives from new addresses in the same window, those bonds are treated as one entity and slashed together, so farming shells burns capital faster than it can earn.
